## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (98%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Flagged reliability (49%), model disagreement, and mostly Normal neighbors reduce trust despite a 98% Benign score.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 98%, Normal 2%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% [F1] | High Benign score; 0% invasive |
| Conformal set | {Benign} (α=10%, 90% test coverage) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 49% (flagged), OOD 64th percentile [F6] | Suspect input; recut/levels orders drafted |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models split |
| Similar cases | 1/5 Benign, 4/5 Normal (87–90% similarity) [F5] | 20% neighbor agreement; mostly Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 7, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.60), but failed AI spot check (0/20) [F2] · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.38) pushes away from invasive risk (19/20) [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 4, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.37) favors benign architecture; caption inconsistent (18/20) [F4] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Low score (+0.35) slightly offsets benign pull (12/20 check) · Weak
- **Nuclear size and immune fraction** (regions 6, 9, 10) · context · Nuclei 45.7 µm² (0th percentile) [F7]; immune cells 8% (91st) [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); normal_lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), and mitoses (0/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Section artifacts (49% reliability, tier 3 flag) mask focal atypia; drafted orders suggest recut H&E or deeper levels.
- Tissue is Normal rather than Benign: 4/5 nearest neighbors (87–88% similarity) are Normal and CONCH–MUSK disagree.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 9, 10**: Check region 6 (13% risk, top TILs) and measured small nuclei with 91st-percentile inflammation.
2. **Regions 7, 8, 11**: Verify lobular architecture (unreliable normal_lobules score) and rule out stromal invasion in region 8.
3. **Regions 1, 4, 10**: Confirm tubule formation and inspect region 4 ducts to separate Benign from Normal.
